review.evidence: At Base block 48592766, GLDY proxy 0x632db1aaace73401a5dc8cde6e9062b8ec0fd819 used UUPS implementation 0xd3a66bf0ecbf910afcc91bd2af3e724656448cb5 with zero admin and beacon slots. Role history contained six grants and no revocations. Legacy EOA 0x889133442bf36e4291c0b2e23b35b260309cb0fe and 2-of-3 Safe 0x655f31f9136d54bc319c00dd43009104646b0951 both held TREASURY_ROLE. Legacy EOA 0x9625c15f7b305680c1690cd41103870e2050028d and 3-of-5 Safe 0x05ed6826524ebe9f3df837b06803ff797f4e2130 independently held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and could immediately grant minters, change reserve configuration, or upgrade mint logic. The source-verified mint path retained its reserve check. EisnerAmper's first independent AICPA examination reconciled GLDY supply to allocated gold reserves at 31 March 2026, but the 1 July 2026 announcement only promises monthly reports going forward. No second report or established recurring independent attestation series was available at review, and no prudential reserve supervisor was established; one EisnerAmper examination therefore supports attestation-only supervision but does not establish a recurring independent attestation cadence. Sol reconciliation adjudication 2026-08-15: at Base block 50021056 the proxy still pointed to source-verified implementation 0xd3a66bf0ecbf910afcc91bd2af3e724656448cb5, Chainlink mode was enabled with the GLDY Reserves Proof of Reserve feed at 0xf488FA1B4Ac8210bf0b2d212176ca28c48F86708, and getReserveStatus returned usingChainlink=true with reported reserves equal to GLDY supply and feed data 31,988 seconds old. Chainlink identifies this Base feed as an off-chain Proof of Reserve feed reported by Streamex. Both mint and batchMint call _getTotalReservesWithSource before _mint; in enabled Chainlink mode that path queries the feed, validates a positive completed round no older than 12 hours, normalizes the answer, and requires reported gold reserves to cover the proposed new total supply at a 100% minimum backing ratio. Oracle fallback was enabled at the observed block, so a failed Chainlink call can substitute a manual reserve figure only when that figure is no older than 12 hours; every successful mint remains mechanically bounded by the same whole-supply coverage comparison. This contract-enforced per-mint comparison is a continuous reconciliation mechanism. That conclusion concerns the always-on mint gate and is separate from the publication cadence of independent attestations, for which only the March 2026 examination was established.
